query:
SELECT
            id,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(octet_length(name) <= $4, FALSE) THEN name
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "name?",
            COALESCE(octet_length(name) <= $4, FALSE) AS "name_within_limit!",
            price,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(octet_length(description) <= $5, FALSE) THEN description
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "description?",
            COALESCE(octet_length(description) <= $5, FALSE) AS "description_within_limit!",
            datetime,
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(octet_length(category) <= $6, FALSE) THEN category
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "category?",
            COALESCE(octet_length(category) <= $6, FALSE) AS "category_within_limit!",
            is_recurring,
            recurring_frequency::text AS "recurring_frequency?",
            CASE
                WHEN receipt_url IS NULL OR octet_length(receipt_url) <= $7
                THEN receipt_url
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "receipt_url?",
            COALESCE(
                receipt_url IS NULL OR octet_length(receipt_url) <= $7,
                FALSE
            ) AS "receipt_url_within_limit!"
        FROM transactions
        WHERE user_id = $1
        ORDER BY datetime DESC
        LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
